tools.name: airtable_create_record
tools.description: Creates a new record in an Airtable table

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name to create record in

fields.description: Object containing field names and their values

typecast.description: Automatically convert values to correct field types (default: false)

tools.name: airtable_create_records_batch
tools.description: Creates multiple records in an Airtable table (up to 10 at once)

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name to create records in

fields.description: Object containing field names and their values

records.description: Array of record objects to create (max 10)

typecast.description: Automatically convert values to correct field types (default: false)

tools.name: airtable_delete_record
tools.description: Deletes a record from an Airtable table

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name containing the record

record_id.description: ID of the record to delete (starts with "rec")

tools.name: airtable_delete_records_batch
tools.description: Deletes multiple records from an Airtable table (up to 10 at once)

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name containing the records

record_ids.description: Array of record IDs to delete (max 10)

tools.name: airtable_get_base_schema
tools.description: Retrieves the schema (structure) of an Airtable base including all tables and fields

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

tools.name: airtable_get_record
tools.description: Retrieves a single record by ID from an Airtable table

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name containing the record

record_id.description: ID of the record to retrieve (starts with "rec")

cell_format.description: How to format cell values (default: json)

tools.name: airtable_get_table_schema
tools.description: Retrieves the schema (structure) of a specific table including all fields

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name to get schema for

tools.name: airtable_list_bases
tools.description: Lists all bases (workspaces) accessible by the user

tools.name: airtable_list_records
tools.description: Lists records from an Airtable table with optional filtering and sorting

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name to list records from

fields.description: Array of field names to return (returns all fields if not specified)

max_records.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 100, max: 100)

page_size.description: Number of records to return per page (default: 100, max: 100)

view.description: Name or ID of a view to use for filtering/sorting

cell_format.description: How to format cell values (default: json)

tools.name: airtable_update_record
tools.description: Updates an existing record in an Airtable table

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name containing the record

record_id.description: ID of the record to update (starts with "rec")

fields.description: Object containing field names and their updated values

typecast.description: Automatically convert values to correct field types (default: false)

replace.description: If true, replaces all fields (unspecified fields cleared). If false, merges (default: false)

tools.name: airtable_update_records_batch
tools.description: Updates multiple records in an Airtable table (up to 10 at once)

base_id.description: ID of the Airtable base (starts with "app")

table_id.description: Table ID or name containing the records

id.description: ID of the record to update (starts with "rec")

fields.description: Object containing field names and their updated values

records.description: Array of record objects to update (max 10)

typecast.description: Automatically convert values to correct field types (default: false)

replace.description: If true, replaces all fields (unspecified fields cleared). If false, merges (default: false)
